evidence.quote: No, that doesn't work for me either. I can't give out my name and zip code

observed_facts: The agent correctly requested authentication via email or name and zip code per policy.
The user refused to provide either email or name and zip code, preventing authentication.
The agent transferred the user to a human agent because authentication could not be completed.
inference: The simulated user's refusal to provide necessary identification information made it impossible for the agent to authenticate the user and proceed with the order exchange.
needs_verification: Whether the user model was designed to refuse standard authentication steps.
parsed.summary: The task failed because the user refused to provide required authentication details (email or name and zip code), forcing a transfer to a human agent.
